export const meta = {
  name: 'hail-b2-round6',
  description: 'B2 round six: D34, the words say exactly what B2 joins (FL.W and FA.A leave the zone list as polygon and county products; the NCEI point kinds named; the rest handed to B5); joins and docs fixers, then a short re-check',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fix', detail: 'joins list, contract rows and tests; docs and About' }, { title: 'Recheck', detail: 'tests, store verify, grep' }],
}
const WT = '/home/user/wt/wt-b2'
const BRIEF = '/home/user/wt/briefs/hail-b2-brief.md'
const OUT = '/home/user/hail-b2/out2'
const STORE_DIR = '/home/user/hail-b1/out2/store/store'
const VENV = '/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python'
const COMMON = `You work in the git worktree ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2). Read the last section of ${BRIEF} ("Supervisor decision after the flood products research (D34) and the round-6 list") first; it is your task list, and the research record /home/user/wt/research-b35/flood-ice-heat-products.json is its evidence. Repository rules (AGENTS.md is in your context): Python first, evidence honesty, feed contracts changed with the parser and the tests together, plain wording in sentence case, no em-dashes, no model, AI-vendor or AI-product names, tests with every behaviour change. The other fixer edits other files in this worktree now: edit only the files you own, never run git checkout, stash, reset, add, commit or push, never reformat a file you do not own, never delete anything outside a folder you created under ${OUT}/<your-name>/. A python with pyarrow and numpy is ${VENV}; the B1 store is ${STORE_DIR}; the joins cache is /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache. Return a plain report: what you changed (file and line), the commands you ran with their tails, and anything not done.`
const JOINS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the joins fixer; you own website/joins.py, tests/test_joins.py and, for this run only, the CONTRACTS rows ncei_storm_events and nws_zone_products in website/sources.py. Apply D34: remove FL.W and FA.A from ZONE_PRODUCTS with a docstring note (polygon and county products; B5 joins them through the polygon and county paths); if the phenomenon words map or any sentence names flood warning or flood watch among the zone products, correct it; the ncei_storm_events row names the point kinds joined (hail and thunderstorm wind) and the zone-coded kinds read, and says that tornado, flood, flash flood, heavy rain, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow points are not joined in this version; the nws_zone_products row lists the nine products exactly (HW.W, WS.W, BZ.W, IS.W, EC.W, WC.W, DS.W, WI.Y, FW.W); tests updated (the list, the words). Then rebuild: copy ${STORE_DIR} to ${OUT}/joins/store-r6, python -m website.joins build --store ${OUT}/joins/store-r6 --cache /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache --procs 4, verify, compare (15 of 15 delta 0 expected), tar as ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz after verify passes (keep the old one as hail-store.tar.gz.r4); report the index counts before and after (zone events should drop by the FL.W and FA.A events, if any were placed; the research says FL.W placed 0 and FA.A kept MTZ events only). Run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_joins tests.test_site tests.test_hail (tail).`
const DOCS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the docs fixer; you own docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json and website/templates/about.html (only if the About paragraph lists the joined kinds there rather than through joins.py's words: check first). Apply D34: D35 and DESIGN section 9 name the joined kinds exactly as D34 lists them and say which kinds B5 adds (tornado, flood, flash flood, heavy rain, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow points; the flood products FL.W, FA.W, FA.Y, FL.A, FL.Y and the county-only FA.A and FF.A; snow squall; the winter, heat, frost and freeze zone products) with the research counts in the window; ROADMAP's B5 row carries the hand-off; the verification record notes D34 and the two corrected claims; the About paragraph, wherever it lives, lists the kinds exactly (read website/joins.py WORDS_JOINS and website/templates/about.html to find the sentence); and set the verification record's gate B2-7, failed_checks, status and verdict from round 5's evidence, which passed: /home/user/hail-b2/out2/r5-site/smoke_pages2.log ends with 'Page width check passed: every page fits the screen at 288, 320, 375, 768, 1440 px, light and dark.' and EXIT 0 after the overflow-wrap rule in town.html line 143 and map.html line 28 (quote both in the record; status pass once every gate but the deferred B2-4 passes). Em-dashes 0; sentence case; no model or AI-vendor names. Report the diff stat and quote the corrected sentences.`
phase('Fix')
const fixes = await parallel([
  () => agent(JOINS, { label: 'fix6:joins', phase: 'Fix', model: WORKER }),
  () => agent(DOCS, { label: 'fix6:docs', phase: 'Fix', model: WORKER }),
])
phase('Recheck')
const recheck = await agent(`Read-only checker in ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2). Read the D34 section of ${BRIEF}. Never edit, stage, commit or push; scratch only under ${OUT}/recheck6/ which you create. Run and quote: ${VENV} -m unittest discover -s tests (tail; all must pass); python desktop/launcher.py --selftest payload; python -m website.joins verify and compare on ${OUT}/joins/store-r6 (or the store the joins fixer named); grep -n "FL.W\\|FA.A\\|flood" website/joins.py website/sources.py docs/DECISIONS.md docs/DESIGN.md website/templates/about.html and judge each hit against D34 (quote any sentence that still claims a flood product or a tornado or flash flood point join in this version); a --hail-history --sample --hail-store <the new tar> build into ${OUT}/recheck6/real with PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium ${VENV} tools/smoke_map.py and tools/smoke_pages.py on it (tails); git -C ${WT} status --short and diff --stat 7aec754; em-dash and banned-name counts over added lines. Return a short JSON: tests, selftest, verify, compare, smoke_map, smoke_pages, the grep judgement, and every check that failed.`, { label: 'recheck6', phase: 'Recheck', model: WORKER })
return { fixes: fixes.map((f) => (f || '').slice(0, 5000)), recheck }

fixes:
Joins fixer report, round 6 (D34). Worktree `/home/user/wt/wt-b2`, branch `claude/hail-b2`. Nothing was committed, staged, or pushed.

**What I changed (my three files only)**

`website/joins.py`
- Lines 5-6: module docstring, the NCEI record kind now names hail and thunderstorm wind points and zone-coded rows.
- Lines 19-20: module docstring, the z/ line gives the nine zone products and says FL.W and FA.A are polygon and county products.
- Lines 123-126: comment block with the D34 note. It says why FL.W and FA.A are not zone products and that B5 joins them through the polygon and county paths.
- Lines 127-128: `ZONE_PRODUCTS` is now the nine: HW.W, WS.W, BZ.W, IS.W, EC.W, WC.W, FW.W, DS.W, WI.Y. FL and FA are removed.
- Line 146: `PRODUCT_NAMES` loses the FL.W and FA.A entries. The old "Flood watch" name for FA.A was also wrong.
- Lines 208-211: `WORDS_JOINS["records_what"]` names hail and thunderstorm wind points within 5 miles and the zone-coded records. It states that tornado, flood, flash flood, heavy rain, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow points are not joined in this version.
- Lines 1898-1899: `_zone_events` docstring counts. The old figures were 110 groups with a NEW row (69 public, 41 fire) and 157 NEW rows. The new figures are 107 (66 public, 41 fire) and 107 rows. The 21 multi-issue groups and the zero two-office keys are unchanged.

`website/sources.py`
- Lines 229-233: `ncei_storm_events` request. It names the points joined, the zone-coded kinds read, and the points not joined.
- Lines 239-241: `ncei_storm_events` missing. A zone-coded row has no coordinates. A county-coded row without coordinates is not joined. This corrects the old claim that a row with no coordinates is zone-coded.
- Lines 284-291: `nws_zone_products` request. It lists the nine products by code and no flood product.
- Lines 304-306: `nws_zone_products` missing. Flood warnings and watches are polygon and county products and are not joined in this version.

`tests/test_joins.py`
- Line 27: imports `website.sources as src`.
- Lines 36-38: `D34_ZONE_PRODUCTS` constant (the nine).
- Lines 182-192: parser test. County-coded tornado, flood, flash flood, heavy rain, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow rows give no points and no zone rows.
- Lines 516-561: `ZoneProductListTests`, seven tests. They check the list, the flood products' absence, the names, the browser product map, the zone words, and both contract rows.
- Lines 597-604: records words test.
- Lines 729-736: offline build test. The zone requests made by the build are exactly the nine products.

**Commands and tails**
- Baseline `tests.test_joins` before edits: `Ran 144 tests ... OK`.
- Baseline `tests.test_site tests.test_hail`: `Ran 333 tests in 173.886s`, `OK`, EXIT=0.
- After edits, `tests.test_joins`: `Ran 154 tests in 6.633s`, `OK`.

- `python -m website.joins build --store .../store-r6 --cache /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache --procs 4`, EXIT=0. Log: `pulled and parsed (62 s)`, `wrote 4597 tile files (14560609 bytes ...) and the events table (5351807 bytes)`, `done in 143 s`. All six parts loaded, zero source failures. Zone requests: 54 (cache 45, fetched 9).
- `verify .../store-r6`: ok, 22 of 22 checks. The extracted candidate tar also verifies, 22 of 22.
- `compare .../store-r6`: 15 of 15 rows delta 0. Last row: `Station days at or above 50 kt 2025 ours=247 research=247 delta=0`.
- Tar: `tar -C store-r6 -czf hail-store.tar.gz.new hail` (12,872,249 bytes). Verified after extraction. The old tar was renamed to `hail-store.tar.gz.r4` (12,876,467 bytes), and the new one is now `hail-store.tar.gz`. Nothing was deleted.
- `/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_joins tests.test_site tests.test_hail`: `Ran 487 tests in 187.320s`, `OK`, EXIT=0. That is 477 existing plus 10 new.

**Index counts, before (round-4 store) and after (store-r6)**
- Public zone events: 4,960 → 4,469. The drop is exactly the 491 FA.A events, spread over all 83 zones. FL.W had 0 events before and after.
- Fire zone events (FW.W): 660 → 660.
- Distinct unplaced zone products: 452 → 429. Zone rows unmatched: 456 → 433.
- Zones: 83 → 83.
- z/ bytes: 919,402 → 875,220. j/ unchanged (19,912,416). s/ unchanged (22,478). Hail total: 20,854,296 → 20,810,114.
- Zone product requests: 66 → 54.
- Unchanged: reports 43,510, NCEI points 1,841, NCEI zone rows 4,748 (451 unmatched), SV 2,240, TO 17, FF 148, station days 1,261.
- Midnight CAN rows in the window: 447 → 405.

**Figures for the docs owner (I did not edit docs)**
- Open item 11, cancellation-only zone groups in the window. My recount reproduces the current 3,411 public, 276 fire, 446 at 00:00 UTC, 298 the day after the product date, and 2,965 at other times. After the change: 3,294 total (3,018 public, 276 fire), 404 public at 00:00 UTC of which 279 the day after, and 2,614 public at other times.
- Zone groups with a NEW row: 11

- D35 joined kinds: "B2 joins these kinds and no others once the D34 change and its rebuild are in (open item 20). Reports: every LSR type the archive returns within 5 miles. - D35 B5 counts (window 2021-10-19 to 2026-10-19): NCEI points tornado 13, flood 60, flash flood 52, heavy rain 85, funnel cloud 30, lightning 6, debris flow 10 (256 rows). IEM events: FL.W 43, FA.W 37, FA.Y 548, FL.A 35, FL.Y 10, SQ.W 78, county-only FA.A 18 and FF.A 2, and WW.Y 865, WS.A 226, HT.Y 58, EH.W 4, EH.A 3, FR.Y 14, FZ.W 4.
- D35 corrected claims: "(a) ZONE_PRODUCTS listed FL.W and FA.A as joined zone products … (b) The research read the brief's NCEI row (line 20) as naming tornado and flash flood among the records. That row, as the brief file reads now …, names hail and thunderstorm wind points only … The gap is real: NCEI's 17 Montana tornado and 60 flash flood rows for 2020 to 2026 are county-coded points, B2 drops them, and B5 takes them."
- DESIGN: "B2 joins the kinds in the first column and no others, once the D34 change and its rebuild are in."
- About, line 59: "Not joined yet: NOAA's county-coded records of tornado, flood, flash flood, heavy rain, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow (those types already appear among the reports when people sent them to the NWS); … Other NWS products are not joined yet."
- Record verdict, first sentence: "Round 6 (2026-10-19): pass for every gate except the deferred B2-4 (units). Gate B2-7 passes on the round-5 build: …"
- Gate B2-7 quotes: `.joins-sec { margin-top: 20px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` (town.html line 143) and `.sheet-body .joins-sec { margin-top: 22px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` (map.html line 28). The log ends "Page width check passed: every page fits the screen at 288, 320, 375, 768, 1440 px, light and dark." then "EXIT 0". I checked the real build contains the rule and the earlier build does not.

**Commands and tails**
- `sed -n '253,269p'` on the brief: the round-6 list; the last line is "Then the supervisor's gate and the push."
- `python3 -I ncei_window.py > ncei_window.json`: exit 0. It reproduces the research's 2020 to 2026 totals (76, 60, 144, 17, 35, 8, 11) and gate B2-2's hail by year (139, 233, 75, 96, 190). The window counts are 60, 52, 85, 13, 30, 6, 10. The research gives calendar totals only, so I computed these from the cache.
- `python3 -I edit_docs6.py`: 8, 5, 4 and 1 replacements, each matched once, exit 0. Two small wording edits followed.
- `python3 -I edit_record6.py`: "record written: 72601 bytes; status pass; open items 29; notes 41", exit 0. A layout round trip was checked first. Two wording edits followed.
- Checks: em-dashes 0 in all five files and in added lines. The only "claude" in added lines is the existing branch name `claude/hail-b2` in the ROADMAP B2 row, which I kept. No forbidden term in the About paragraph.
- Read-only git: `status`, `log`, `show`, `diff --stat`, `diff --numstat`.
- Scratch files are in `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/docs-fixer/r6/`.

**Not done**
- Unit tests were not run. The About phrases were checked by string match against the test's list, and the page was not rendered in Chromium.
- The D34 code change belongs to the joins owner. It covers `ZONE_PRODUCTS` in `joins.
